admin.brandsIntro: Define the brands of your products: name and slug per language, a short description and a logo. A brand with products cannot be deleted.
admin.specsIntro: The shop's specs (such as "Screen size" or "Colour"): kind, name per language, group, unit and options. Product pages list them in this order. The kind of a spec in use is fixed.
admin.specKindFixed: Products use this spec; its kind is fixed.
admin.optionInUse: A product or variant uses this option.
admin.specInUse: A product or variant uses this spec.
admin.templateHint: The specs this category's products usually have; the product editor lists them first.
admin.templateHintSub: Added to the category's template (the greyed ones come from the category).
admin.productStockFromVariants: The sum of the variants' stock
admin.variantsIntro: Choose up to three choice-list specs, tick their options and press "Build combinations". Each variant has its own SKU and stock; an empty price means the product's price.
admin.variantNoOptionSpecs: There is no choice-list spec; create one on the Specs page.
admin.variantSpecBlocked: The product has its own value for this spec.
admin.seoIntro: The title and description search engines show, and extra search words. Left empty, they come from the product's name and description.

seoWarnings.titleLong: The title is longer than 60 characters and will be cut in results.
seoWarnings.descriptionMissing: There is no description; search engines will pick some text themselves.
seoWarnings.descriptionLong: The description is longer than 160 characters and will be cut.
seoWarnings.notTranslated: The name is not translated: this language's page stays out of search results.

admin.synonymsIntro: Words that mean the same; searching for one also finds the others (such as "phone, mobile, cell phone"). A word is in one group per language only.
admin.redirectsIntro: Send the addresses of a previous website or moved pages to their new address, so links and search rankings are kept. Product addresses carry a stable number and need none. Changes apply within a minute.
admin.redirectImportHint: One per line: old address, new address and, if needed, 301, 302 or 410. Full addresses of the old site work too. An existing old address is updated.

seoErrors.locale_invalid: The shop does not offer this language.
seoErrors.too_few_terms: At least two different words are needed.
seoErrors.term_too_long: A word has at most 50 characters.
seoErrors.term_in_other_group: One of the words is already in another group of this language.
seoErrors.path_invalid: The old address must be a path such as /old-page (not the home page or /api).
seoErrors.target_invalid: The new address must be a path on this site or an http(s) address.
seoErrors.path_taken: This old address already has a redirect.
seoErrors.redirect_loop: An address cannot redirect to itself.
seoErrors.redirect_chain: Point straight at the final address (no chains of redirects).

admin.importProductsIntro: Download the products as Excel or CSV, edit them and upload the file. Rows are matched by "number" or SKU; a row without a match creates a product. Only the columns in the file change: a file with "sku" and "price" only updates prices. New categories and brands are created.
importColumnsHelp: sku (required), number (to change an SKU), price, compare_at_price, stock, published (yes/no)
group: "Category > Sub-category > Group" and brand, by name
Per language: name:en, slug:en, description:en, meta_title:en, meta_description:en, tags:en
Specs: spec:code (such as spec:color); an option by its code or its name in any language. An empty cell removes the value.
Persian digits and thousands separators are accepted. At most 5,000 rows and 10 MB.
admin.importStockIntro: Update stock only, with two columns: sku and stock. Variant SKUs (colour, size) work too; a product with variants gets the sum of its variants' stock.
admin.importCheckFirst: Check the file first; without problems, Import becomes available.
admin.importProblems: {count} problem(s) found; nothing was saved. Fix the file and check again.
